mod.name: Carry On
mod.text:
Fork of the mod by copygirl - CarryCapacity. Carry On lets you pick up and move placed blocks - especially containers - with their contents intact, in your hands and on your back.

Carry On 2.0.0-rc.1 - release candidate

This is the first release candidate of Carry On 2.0, a major rewrite of the carry system. Please play with care and back up your world and your CarryOnConfig.json before updating. If you may want to return to 1.x, keep a copy of the old config too.

Carry On 2.0 requires CarryOnLib (also install it) and Vintage Story 1.22.0 or newer.

What's new in 2.0

  • Blocks look right while carried. Flowerpots and planters show their plant, display cases show their contents, labelled chests and signs show their text, labelled crates show a content icon, and chiselled blocks show their chiselled shape.
  • Back-carried blocks fit your backpack. Blocks on your back are positioned for small and large backpacks, with straps added to most of them.
  • Carry bags from ground storage. With empty hands, lift a backpack, hand basket, sack or quiver out of ground storage, contents intact, and open a bag in ground storage while your hands are full.
  • Cluster carry. Carry a block together with the wall signs attached to it, as a single unit.
  • Speed and hunger. Carrying slows you down and can increase hunger, both configurable per block and per slot.
  • Damage no longer drops your block from a scratch. A trip or hunger pang no longer makes you drop what you carry; only serious damage does.
  • Safer dropped blocks. A block that cannot be placed drops as a recoverable crate entity, owned by you for a grace period, instead of spilling its contents.
  • Live config. Many settings apply on reload without restarting the server.
  • Clean upgrades. A container carried on your back when you upgrade from 1.14 keeps its contents.

Installation

  1. Download Carry On from this page.
  2. Download CarryOnLib.
  3. Open the mod folder from the in-game Mod Manager and copy both .zip files in without extracting them.

Alternatively, use the Vintage Story Launcher to manage the mod.

How to carry

Pick up a supported block with both hands empty: hold the carry modifier (default Shift) and hold right-click. A progress circle appears at the cursor.

  • Place it back down: while carrying it in your hands, hold the carry modifier and right-click against a block.
  • Put it on your back: hold the carry modifier and the swap-back modifier (default Ctrl) together and right-click - aiming does not matter - or aim at open space with only the carry modifier held.
  • Take it back off your back: the same interaction again.
  • Interact while carrying: doors, trapdoors, fence gates, barrels, chests, reed chests and storage vessels can still be used - hold the interact button until the spinner completes.

Supported blocks include chests, barrels, crates, reed chests, storage vessels (including cracked ones), anvils, planters, querns and more. A smaller set can be worn on the back; reed chests are among the lightest to carry there. See the full Vanilla Block Inventory.

Controls

Carry On uses two interaction modifiers (held with right-click) and four function hotkeys. All can be rebound in the in-game controls menu.

Carry On keybinds only appear in the controls list after a world has been loaded.

Interaction modifiers

  • Carry action - default Shift (used with right-click to pick up, place and interact).
  • Swap-back - default Ctrl (used with the carry action to move blocks to and from your back).

The carry modifier defaults to the same key as Sneak, and the swap-back modifier to the same key as Sprint - Carry On is designed to work that way. Vintage Story's keybind conflict detection will likely flag this: the Carry On bindings may show same as Sneak or same as Sprint, and the Sneak and Sprint bindings may point back at the Carry On keys. This is expected and harmless - it comes from the newer conflict detection and does not affect play.

Carry On supports single-key bindings for these two modifiers only, and warns in chat if the carry and swap-back keys are bound to the same key.

Function hotkeys

  • Toggle Carry On - default Alt + K (useful when Carry On conflicts with another mod).
  • Quick drop from hands - default K.
  • Quick drop from hands and back - default Alt + Ctrl + K.
  • Toggle double-tap dismount - default Ctrl + K (for boats, rafts and elk).

If you are unable to put a block down, use Alt + Ctrl + K to force-drop it. See Known Issues below.

While you carry

  • Movement: carrying slows you down per slot - by default about 25% slower in your hands and 15% slower on your back. Sprinting while carrying in your hands is disabled by default, with many per-block and per-material overrides available.
  • Hunger: carrying on your back can increase hunger drain, with a floor so it never starves you; off by default for the hands slot.
  • Damage: you still drop what is in your hands or on your back, but only once damage exceeds a per-slot threshold - light falls and hunger pangs no longer count. The back slot takes heavier damage before it drops.
  • Death: a block on your back drops at the location where you died. If that spot is on land you cannot build on, the block drops as a recoverable entity rather than spilling its contents.

Dropped blocks

When a carried block cannot be placed - an occupied spot, a claim you cannot build on, or no ground - it drops as a small crate entity instead of spilling. The block keeps its contents and data, so you can pick it back up. The dropper has a grace period of exclusive pickup, after which anyone can take it. By default a dropped block entity despawns after 30 in-game days. This is configurable in the CarriedBlockEntity section of CarryOnConfig.json.

Cluster carry (wall signs)

When enabled on the server, a block is picked up together with any wall signs attached to it and placed back as a unit. Players can choose whether they render and/or pick up attached signs:

  • .carryon attachedRender [true|false]
  • .carryon attachedPickup [true|false]

Carried appearance

Carry On renders carried blocks with their details, not just the base model: plant containers show their plant, labelled chests show their label, and chiselled blocks show their chiselled shape.

Multiplayer and claims

  • Pickup and placement are checked against the whole block footprint - the target block, any part of a multiblock, and any attached wall signs - on the server.
  • You cannot pick up dropped blocks on trader land or on claims you do not have permission for; those blocks drop as entities instead.
  • Carry interactions are range-checked on the server, so a modified client cannot act on distant blocks.

Configuration

Server and single-player behavior is configured through CarryOnConfig.json in the ModConfig folder. The file is created with defaults if missing, and older configs are upgraded automatically. Most common edits:

  • Carryables / CarryablesOnBack - which vanilla block families can be carried in the hands or on the back.
  • Interactables - which blocks can still be used while your hands are full.
  • CarryWalkSpeed / CarryHungerRate - per-slot and per-block movement and hunger modifiers, including global and per-material multipliers.
  • DropCarriedOnDamage - per-slot damage thresholds before a carried block is dropped.
  • CarriedBlockEntity - how dropped blocks behave: drop mode, rotation, particles, despawn timer and pickup access.
  • CarryOptions - reach, interaction speed, back-slot toggles, cluster carry, ground-storage bags and backpack selection.
  • CarryablesFilters - automatic matching rules for modded blocks.

Most settings apply at runtime when the config is reloaded (requires DebuggingOptions.ReconditionOnConfigChange to be enabled at server start). See CarryOn Config Reference for every field, default and upgrade note.

Default CarryOnConfig.json (key sections)
{
  "ConfigVersion": 6,
  "Carryables": {
    "Anvil": true,
    "Barrel": true,
    "Chest": true,
    "Crate": true,
    "LootVessel": true,
    "Planter": true,
    "Quern": true,
    "ReedChest": true,
    "Resonator": true,
    "StorageVessel": true
  },
  "CarryablesOnBack": {
    "Barrel": true,
    "Chest": true,
    "Flowerpot": true,
    "LootVessel": true,
    "Planter": true,
    "ReedChest": true,
    "Resonator": true,
    "StorageVessel": true
  },
  "Interactables": { "Door": true, "Barrel": true, "Storage": true },
  "CarryWalkSpeed": {
    "HandsEnabled": true,
    "BackEnabled": true,
    "HandsAllowSprint": false,
    "BackAllowSprint": true,
    "ModifierOverrides": {
      "SlotDefaults": { "Hands": -0.25, "Back": -0.15 }
    }
  },
  "CarryHungerRate": {
    "HandsEnabled": false,
    "BackEnabled": true,
    "MinSaturationThreshold": 150.0,
    "ModifierOverrides": {
      "SlotDefaults": { "Hands": 0.2, "Back": 0.3 }
    }
  },
  "DropCarriedOnDamage": {
    "HandsEnabled": true,
    "BackEnabled": true,
    "HandsDamageThreshold": 1.0,
    "BackDamageThreshold": 6.0
  },
  "CarryOptions": {
    "RemoveInteractDelayWhileCarrying": false,
    "InteractSpeedMultiplier": 1.0,
    "MaxInteractionDistance": 6,
    "BackSlotEnabled": true,
    "TooHotToCarry": true,
    "CarryAttachedWallSigns": false,
    "OpenGroundStorageBagWhileCarrying": true,
    "BackpackSelectionMode": "LastFound"
  },
  "CarriedBlockEntity": {
    "DropMode": "EntityOnFailedPlacement",
    "RandomDropRotation": true,
    "DespawnAfterDays": 30,
    "PickupAccess": "OwnerFirst",
    "GracePeriodSeconds": 300
  },
  "DebuggingOptions": { "LoggingEnabled": false, "DisableHarmonyPatch": false }
}

The fragment above is trimmed for readability. The full file is generated with all keys and values; see the config reference for the complete schema.

Chat commands

Carry On adds client and server commands for tuning the on-screen carry indicators and for server admin tasks:

  • .carryon attachedRender [true|false] / .carryon attachedPickup [true|false] - cluster carry visibility and pickup.
  • .carryon gui ... - move, colour and toggle the carry indicator anchors (hands and back) around the hotbar.
  • .carryon iconmode [mode] - carried label icon rendering, for troubleshooting.
  • /carryon-reload - reload the server config without restarting.
  • /carryon-recover [radius] - recover carried data left behind after a crash or mod removal.

See CarryOn Chat Commands for the full list and examples.

Mod compatibility

Carry On supports modded blocks in three ways: it automatically assigns carry behavior to blocks that match known patterns, it ships compatibility patches for a curated set of mods, and mod authors can add the behavior themselves. See the Mod Support Inventory and the Automatic Behavior Assignment guide.

Recommended Mods

A selection of mods regularly tested with Carry On, in no particular order.

  • Japanese translation of Mods (including Carry On)
  • Extra Chests
  • Better Crates
  • Primitive Survival
  • Vanilla Variants
  • Bricklayers
  • Sortable Storage
  • Cartwright's Caravan
  • Upgradeable Storage
  • Player Model Lib

Known Issues

  • Cannot put a carried block down. Usually caused by rebinding the carry keys. Workarounds: force-drop with Alt + Ctrl + K, toggle Carry On with Alt + K, and in Settings > Controls uncheck and re-check "Mouse click modifiers locked to Sneak/Sprint keys".
  • Multi-block carryables are not fully supported. Large multi-block structures can delete neighbouring blocks when dropped; chest trunks are handled correctly.

See the full Known Issues list for causes and workarounds.

Having issues?

Contact me on Discord: nerdscurvy, or in the Carry On channel: Vintage Story > mods > Carry On (on the Official Vintage Story Discord).

To help resolve issues, send me your logs:

  • client-main.txt
  • client-debug.txt
  • server-main.txt
  • server-debug.txt

More detail can be captured by setting "LoggingEnabled": true in CarryOnConfig.json.

Support the author

Please support my caffeine consumption

releases.changelog:
CarryOn 2.0.0-rc.1 is the first release candidate of the 2.0 line. It requires Vintage Story 1.22.0 or newer and the matching CarryOnLib 1.0.0-rc.1. This is a release candidate: back up your world before updating.

New

  • Carry bags from ground storage. With empty hands, hold Pick Up + right-click on a backpack, hand basket, sack or quiver lying in a storage pile to lift just that bag into your hands, contents intact. Put it back into an aimed slot, or stow it in a free worn-bag slot.
  • Open ground-storage bags while carrying. Hold Ctrl + right-click on a pile to open the bag inside without putting your carry down.
  • A new safe way to pick up whole entities. Content authors can require a deliberate key combination before racks, boats and other entities are picked up, so they are no longer grabbed by accident.
  • Hidden backpacks just work. If a cosmetic mod hides your worn backpack, the block you carry now sits at the no-backpack position automatically.
  • Missing blocks still show. A carried block from a removed mod now renders as a placeholder instead of an invisible or white-cube carry.
  • More usable while carrying. Wattle and bamboo gates, and Medieval Architecture gates, drawbridges, portcullis and trapdoors, can be opened and closed while you carry.
  • Safe update from 1.14. A container carried on your back at logout keeps its contents when you upgrade to 2.0.

Fixes

  • Ghost and duplicate blocks left behind by a refused placement are gone.
  • Editing CarryOnConfig.json while the server runs no longer wipes your settings.
  • Turning a block's carryable or carry-on-back setting off and on again now works without a restart.
  • Messages and toasts show in your own language, not the server's.
  • Fixed a client crash when moving between worlds.
  • Fixed a crash when a creative player detaches a carried block from a mod that is no longer installed.
  • A vehicle cargo barrel can no longer be pulled straight into your inventory.

For modders

  • Behavior codes are now namespaced (carryon:carryable). Old bare names still work.
  • The block transfer interface is renamed to ICarryableBlockSlotHandler, and entity handlers are split into a pickup handler and a spawner factory. Mods built against 1.0.0-pre.* must update.
  • See the CarryOnLib release notes and the README on GitHub for migration steps.

Visit the project for documentation and support: GitHub.

• Block trunks and collapsed chests from being attached to boats.
  • Fixed containers, attached to boats, that had never been opened losing their storage slots when detached and re-attached.
  • Fixed attaching items to occupied seats on vehicles like Cartwright's Caravan.
  • Spectators no longer see carry HUD and carried blocks visuals while observing.

CarryOn v2.0.0-pre.8

What's New

  • Walk speed and hunger rate multipliers. New `Multipliers` section in both `CarryWalkSpeed` and `CarryHungerRate` config. Scale penalties globally or by block material (wood, stone, ceramic, metal) without editing per-block overrides. A multiplier of `0.5` halves the penalty; `2.0` doubles it.
  • Carryable report. New debug tool that generates a comprehensive report of every carryable block with its resolved walk speed and hunger rate modifiers. Shows both base values and final values after multipliers are applied. Output formats: markdown, HTML, or server log. Supports block code filters with wildcard patterns and has four condensation modes — collapse identical cardinal-direction variants, group blocks with matching modifiers, or detect wildcard patterns like `flowerpot-*-fired`. Enable via `DebuggingOptions.CarryableReport.Enabled` in config. Report files are written to `ModData/carryon/reports/`.
  • Icon texture mode command. New `.carryon iconmode` chat command to control how carried label icons are rendered. Modes: `standalone` (default on OpenGL 4.3+), `atlas` (all platforms), `standalone-fallback`, `disabled`. Useful for diagnosing icon fading or macOS compatibility. Standalone uses its own copy of icon textures - the copy method depends on the detected OpenGL version.

Improvements

  • Config reload diagnostic logging. Config file changes, reloads, and client sync events now emit debug-level log messages. Makes it easier to diagnose config hot-reload issues without reading source code.
  • Config watcher toggle. New `DisableConfigWatcher` option in `DebuggingOptions` to disable the file system watcher that hot-reloads config on change. Useful for automated config management setups.
  • Refactoring. Clean-up and refactoring, including moving CarryCodes, CarryOnConfig and other frequently changed classes out of CarryOnLib and into CarryOn

Bug Fixes

  • Planter transform group ordering. Fixed carried flowerpots and planters checking for hands-planted default before plant specific transforms. Plant-specific transforms (sapling type, mushroom type, flower type) are now correctly resolved.
  • Prevent Crash on Mac. Added fallback for texture handling on older GL versions used by some Macs.

Requires CarryOnLib v1.0.0-pre.7

  • Allow BlockEntityData to be null in carryable transfers.
  • Fix QP chiseled sign config patch that replaced all behaviors.
  • Fix persisting stale carryon config.

Fix client crash when carrying chiseled blocks:

  • Guard against disposed meshRefs
  • Rebuild cached render info
  • Prune stale cache

CarryOn v2.0.0-pre.5

New Features

  • Hunger modifier support: New CarryHungerRate config section with per-slot HungerRateMultiplier overrides. Modifiers can be configured as flat values or resolved per-slot. A MinSaturationThreshold option stops hunger when saturation drops below a configured level. (Analogous to walk speed modifier system.)
  • Damage drop behavior: New DropCarriedOnDamage config section. Carried blocks can be dropped on taking damage. Configured per slot with a configurable DamageThreshold (damage must be strictly greater than this value to trigger a drop). Healing damage is excluded.
  • Carried block entities: When CarriedBlockEntity.DropMode is set to EntityAlways or EntityWhenSupported, carried blocks are spawned as EntityCarriedBlock entities (rather than item drops). Entities include:
    • Grace period before pickup is allowed
    • Access policy configuration (who can pick up)
    • Configurable despawn timer
    • Z-fighting prevention offset
    • Collision-aware spawn position resolution
  • Hot-reloadable config: FileSystemWatcher watches the config file and triggers a live reload on change. No server restart required. Changes are synced to connected clients. Includes 500ms debounce to handle multi-pass editor writes.
  • Server-client config sync: Config changes are synced to connected clients via ConfigSyncMessage.
  • Permission service: New CarryPermissionService validates carry, drop, and pickup permissions on the server. Client performs a best-effort pre-check for responsiveness.
  • CarriedBlockEntity interaction support: CarryInteractionController and CarryInteractionStateMachine updated to handle interaction with EntityCarriedBlock (pick up dropped entities with Use / Sneak + Use).

Breaking Changes

  • Transform resolver config rename: transformGroupResolver → rootGroupResolver + attachmentGroupResolver in JSON and C# config. defaultRenderFacing → rootRenderFacing.
  • IgnoreCarrySpeedPenalty removed: This config option is no longer consumed. Walk speed modifiers are always applied unless the slot is disabled via the new Enabled flags. The old AllowSprintWhileCarrying behavior was previously waiving both sprint and speed penalty; now sprint and speed are handled independently.
  • Walk speed penalty always applied: Previously, setting AllowSprintWhileCarrying = true entirely waived the speed penalty. Now sprint permission and speed penalty are independent. Players upgrading from configs that set AllowSprintWhileCarrying = true will now receive speed penalties even when sprinting is permitted. The new config schema uses CarryWalkSpeed.HandsAllowSprint to replace the old flat flag.

Bug Fixes

  • PlantContainerTransformGroupResolver returns false for empty pots. Previously returned true with an empty AttachmentResolveResult, generating unnecessary cache entries for empty containers.
  • Single shared PlantContainerTransformGroupResolver instance. Was previously creating two instances for root and attachment registration; now uses one shared instance for consistent state.
  • Removed dead null-forgiving operators. Cleaned up unnecessary ?. and ! on null-conditional chains in PackAdjustmentEditor.cs, PackAdjustmentHandler.cs, and PackAdjustmentLogger.cs.

Internal Changes

  • New network messages: ConfigSyncMessage ([ProtoContract]) and PickupEntityMessage for entity pickup.
  • New entity types: EntityCarriedBlock - a new entity class for dropped carried blocks with configurable pickup, grace period, and despawn behavior.
  • New services:
    • CarriedBlockEntityService - spawning and position resolution for carried block entities.
    • CarryOnConfigService - file watcher–based config reloading with debounce.
    • CarryPermissionService - centralized permission checking.
  • New resolvers:
    • HungerRateModifierResolver — resolves hunger rate modifiers per slot with configurable range (0–9×) and saturation threshold.
    • DataAttributeTransformGroupResolver — resolves transform groups from block entity data attributes.
  • Refactored services:
    • CarryDropService - restructured drop logic with DropBlockAsEntityOrItem supporting EntityAlways, EntityWhenSupported, and Items modes. Handles data attribute spilling before inventory spilling to prevent item duplication.
    • CarryStateService - refactored walk-speed and hunger-rate application into dedicated resolver methods.
    • CarryHandler - migrated from entity.GetCarried() to carryManager.GetCarried().
    • TransferLogic - simplified primary constructor, null-safe carryManager access.
  • EntityBehaviorDropCarriedOnDamage - New entity behavior (server-side) added to existing entities dynamically. Checks all carry slots against per-slot damage thresholds on OnEntityReceiveDamage.
  • CarriedBlockAccessPolicy - Determines pickup access for dropped entity blocks based on owner, party, or everyone.
  • CarriedBlockTreeSerializer - Serialization round-trip for block entity data on carried block entities.

Requires CarryonLib 1.0.0-pre.4

  • Fixed player able to pickup trader blocks in survival
  • Added BackpackSelectionMode to help CarryOn to select which backpack profile to use. [FirstFound|LastFound|FirstOnly] (Workaround for some mods that affect which backpack is rendered)
  • Cluster Carry: Wall signs attached to blocks can now be picked up, carried, and placed as a single unit. 
  • Added attachedTransform to LabelRenderSettings - an optional modifier transform applied only for attached-block label rendering, allowing the label position to be tuned independently from the standalone carried case
  • Added validation in CarryAttachmentService to prevent attaching blocks with carried wall signs to entities (boats), since the inventory conversion would silently drop the attached signs
  • Added defaultRenderVariant - allows block behaviors to specify an alternative block variant for carried rendering (e.g., wall sign model instead of ground sign)
  • Added defaultRenderFacing - controls which facing variant is used when rendering carried blocks that normalize to a default direction on pickup
  • Various render performance improvements

Requires CarryonLib 1.0.0-pre.3

  • Walk speed modifier overrides - configure carry movement speed per block or block type for hands and back slots.
  • Removed broken carried block lighting and - cleaned up chat commands.
  • Interaction system refactored - the monolithic interaction logic was split into a dedicated controller, state machine, and validator for better reliability.
  • Rendering improvements - updated the entity carry renderer and transform template system.
  • Harmony patching extracted to a dedicated utility class.
  • Removed deprecated Shoulder slot support.
  • General stability improvements with better null safety across the API.

Requires CarryonLib 1.0.0-pre.2

  • Reed chest carried on back no longer slows player down (reverted to original behaviour)
  • Add carryable support for Muck Bin (Interesting Mining & Extraction mod)
  • Fixed stuck carry animation after failed pickup
  • Cabinet carry behaviour is now gated by enabledCondition carryon.Carryables.Cabinet
  • Fixed carried signs/labels from trimming leading whitespace and blank lines
  • Added support for sit/crouch-specific carry animations via animationSit and animationCrouch in carryable slot settings
  • Clean-up of rendering, transform group resolver and caching behaviour to improve performance

Overhaul of CarryOn

Changelog

Probably the last VS 1.20 release.

Changelog

 

  • Fixed multiplayer crash that was present in v1.9.7
  • New server options added to CarryOnConfig
    • AllowSprintWhileCarrying - when true, players can still sprint while carrying chests, etc. (Default: false)
    • IgnoreCarrySpeedPenalty - when true, players will have normal movement speed when carrying block in hands and on back (Default: false)
    • RemoveInteractDelayWhileCarrying - when true, players can open doors and chests instantly while carrying a block in their hands. (Default: false)
    • InteractSpeedMultiplier - a variable multiplier to change the speed it of the progress circle when interacting with carryable blocks (Default 1.0)
  • Add interaction while carrying to containers from chiseltools and sortablestorage mods

Changelog

  • Prevent boat containers from being removed if another player is accessing the inventory
  • Improved doubletap dismount (Toggle on/off with CTRL+K)
  • Add patch to detect boat seat desync
    • Vanilla issue with players remaining registered with seat after dismount
  • Add config to disable harmony patches for debugging (Will disable doubletap detection and boat seat desync detection)

Changelog

  • Add hotkey to toggle the Double Tap Dismount feature: Ctrl+K
  • Increase time to register second tap

 

Due to some players experiencing issues with the Double Tap Dismount feature, especially those on large servers, it has been disabled by default.

Each player can enable it again with Ctrl+K 
A message will appear in the chat showing the toggled status.
